shadows.name: default-stamp
shadows.purpose: Nav bar and the main button hover.

motion.name: duration-hero

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Yellow action with a hard ink stamp.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #FFE566; color: #000000; border: 3px solid #000000; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #000000; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 24px; padding: 12px 24px; transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #000000; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FF4D1A; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px) scale(0.98); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000000; }

components.name: Cream Button
components.description: Secondary action on the raised surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-cream { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; border: 3px solid #000000; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #000000; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 24px; padding: 12px 24px; } .ds-btn-cream:hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #000000; } .ds-btn-cream:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FF4D1A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Proof Chip
components.description: Short proof label under the hero.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; border: 3px solid #000000; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #000000; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 20px; padding: 8px 12px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Square surface card with a large stamp.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; border: 3px solid #000000; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #000000; padding: 32px 24px; font-family: "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace; text-align: center; } .ds-card h2 { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 36px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-card p { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 24px; margin: 0; }

components.name: Top Nav
components.description: Sticky bar. The only blurred surface.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; max-width: 1160px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 16px; background: rgba(255, 255, 251, 0.92); border: 3px solid #000000; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #000000; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); font-family: "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace; } .ds-nav-brand, .ds-nav a { color: #000000; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: #FFE566; border: 2px solid #000000; }

narrative.overview:
The public site is sharp type on a near-white field (#FFFFFB). Blocks are rectangles with thick black borders and hard offset shadows that do not blur. Yellow carries the main button, eyebrows, and proof chips. A hot accent is reserved for small stamps, dots, and the focus ring. One monospace face does every job on the public pages.

This file records the CSS the live HTML already ships. It does not restyle those pages. Brand locks override Impeccable skill defaults. Carbon and Hex, recorded under Colors, are house palettes. They are not a license to recolor this site.

Homepage sections are centre-aligned. Journal pages keep a left-aligned reading column under a centred header. The homepage hero is offer-first and creative. It does not open as an HKEX, listings, or filings frame.
keyCharacteristics: Sharp rectangles with a 3px black border
Near-white field (#FFFFFB), yellow action, hot accent, black ink

rules.name: The Public CSS Rule
rules.body: Frontmatter colors are the live public site. Carbon and Hex stay house tracks until Louis asks for a recolor.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Public pages use the JetBrains Mono stack already in the HTML. Nunito Sans stays on the Chrome extension.

rules.name: The Stamp Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth is a hard offset with zero blur. Do not replace it with a soft or glowing shadow.

rules.name: The Sharp Block Rule
rules.body: Cards, buttons, and the nav stay square-cornered. Circles are the accent dots only.

dos: Do use the live tokens in the frontmatter for public pages.
Do keep hard offset, zero-blur shadows.
Do keep 3px ink borders on blocks and 2px ink borders on eyebrows and dots.
Do leave MotionSites ads, links, and branding out of client deliverable files.
donts: Don't recolor the public pages with Carbon or Hex unless Louis asks.
Don't swap the public face to Nunito Sans or to an Impeccable default face.
Don't introduce pill buttons, blur-glow shadows, or purple gradients.
Don't copy the homepage hero’s ink-to-muted text gradient onto other headings.
Don't treat white-on-accent or muted-on-yellow as the contrast target. Those pairings are in the live CSS; this pass does not restyle them.
Don't put MotionSites branding in deliverables.
